name: scsrg
description: Multi-Hazard Smart Campus Safety & Response Grid (SCS-RG)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,backend,frontend -c magenta,cyan,green "pnpm --filter @scsrg/shared dev" "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @scsrg/shared build && pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @scsrg/shared test && pnpm --filter backend test && pnpm --filter frontend test
scripts.db:reset: pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:deploy: pnpm --filter backend exec prisma migrate deploy
